steps.title: Mr. Okafor (landlord): tenant maintenance handbook · part 1
steps.detail: Mr. Okafor (landlord) asks for a tenant maintenance handbook. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Mr. Okafor (landlord): tenant maintenance handbook · part 2
steps.detail: The tenant maintenance handbook now has conflicting notes. Mr. Okafor (landlord) wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain

steps.title: Mr. Okafor (landlord): tenant maintenance handbook · part 3
steps.detail: Mr. Okafor (landlord) is ready to introduce a paying client for the tenant maintenance handbook. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented tenant maintenance handbook. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Mr. Okafor (landlord).
